overview_description.description:
Pemo is an all-in-one spend management solution that empowers your business by packing every company invoice, expense, approval and spending decision into one powerful platform.

Our offering includes smart corporate cards, invoice payment systems and expense tracking functions. These are supported by automated approval flows, direct accounting integration and real-time reporting - features that allow business owners to save time, save money, automate admin and every expense so you can get on with what you do best - building great businesses.

product.name: Corporate Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual prepaid corporate cards powered by Mastercard for business expense management, accepted globally for online and in-store purchases.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A platform that automates expense tracking, receipt collection, real-time spend monitoring, and approval workflows for businesses.

product.name: Accounting Automation
product.description: Software that integrates with accounting systems to auto-categorize expenses and sync transactions in real time, reducing manual bookkeeping.

product.name: Invoice Management
product.description: A system to collect, review, approve, and track invoices with automated workflows and real-time visibility, integrated with accounting software.

product.name: Pemo Digital Wallets
product.description: Digital wallet accounts that allow businesses to store, manage, and spend corporate funds through Pemo’s platform.
